dashboard.name: Discover templates
dashboard.description: Production template adoption, navigation, and creator returns. Empty until instrumentation is deployed. Returns use mature UTC cohorts; blank rates mean no eligible cohort. Profiles are not accounts. Navigation is not editing. Fixed 30-day activity / 90-day cohorts.

insights.name: Discover: template adoption (30 days)
insights.description: Successful created spaces and identified creator profiles in the last 30 days. Seeding must succeed. Empty until deployment. Unknown catalog IDs remain visible.
insights.query:
WITH creations AS (
 SELECT toString(properties.space_id) AS space_id,
 argMin(toString(properties.template_id), timestamp) AS template_id,
 argMin(distinct_id, timestamp) AS creator,
 argMin(toString(properties.identity_state), timestamp) AS creator_identity,
 min(timestamp) AS created_at
 FROM events
 WHERE event = 'space_conversion' AND properties.conversion = 'created'
 AND properties.environment = 'production'
 AND match(toString(properties.template_id), '^[a-f0-9]{16}$')
 AND match(toString(properties.space_id), '^[a-f0-9]{16}$')
 GROUP BY space_id
)
 SELECT multiIf(template_id = '4ef4920da44a6ec2', 'kanoodel', template_id = '9b6eef20ae02d51a', 'little writer', template_id = '7b794d9527299625', 'Nightsky', template_id = 'fd4c8cd7dd36c33d', 'Welcome to Tonk', concat('Unlisted template ', template_id)) AS template, count() AS created_spaces,
 uniqExactIf(creator, creator_identity = 'profile' AND match(creator, '^tonk:[a-f0-9]{64}$')) AS identified_creators,
 countIf(creator_identity != 'profile' OR NOT match(creator, '^tonk:[a-f0-9]{64}$')) AS creations_without_profile
 FROM creations WHERE created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
 GROUP BY template_id ORDER BY created_spaces DESC

insights.name: Discover: template reach (30 days)
insights.description: Identified profiles navigating into attributed spaces in the last 30 days. Includes creation-day opens and collaborators. Navigation is not proof of rendering or editing. Profiles are not people or accounts.
insights.query:
WITH creations AS (
 SELECT toString(properties.space_id) AS space_id,
 argMin(toString(properties.template_id), timestamp) AS template_id,
 argMin(distinct_id, timestamp) AS creator,
 argMin(toString(properties.identity_state), timestamp) AS creator_identity,
 min(timestamp) AS created_at
 FROM events
 WHERE event = 'space_conversion' AND properties.conversion = 'created'
 AND properties.environment = 'production'
 AND match(toString(properties.template_id), '^[a-f0-9]{16}$')
 AND match(toString(properties.space_id), '^[a-f0-9]{16}$')
 GROUP BY space_id
), entries AS (SELECT toString(properties.space_id) AS space_id, distinct_id AS profile,
 timestamp AS entered_at, toString(properties.identity_state) AS identity_state
 FROM events WHERE event = 'space_entered' AND properties.environment = 'production'
 AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY)
 SELECT multiIf(template_id = '4ef4920da44a6ec2', 'kanoodel', template_id = '9b6eef20ae02d51a', 'little writer', template_id = '7b794d9527299625', 'Nightsky', template_id = 'fd4c8cd7dd36c33d', 'Welcome to Tonk', concat('Unlisted template ', template_id)) AS template, uniqExact(e.profile) AS visiting_profiles,
 uniqExact(c.space_id) AS visited_spaces,
 uniqExactIf(e.profile, e.profile = c.creator) AS visiting_creators,
 uniqExactIf(e.profile, e.profile != c.creator) AS visiting_collaborators
 FROM entries e JOIN creations c ON e.space_id = c.space_id
 WHERE e.identity_state = 'profile' AND match(e.profile, '^tonk:[a-f0-9]{64}$') AND e.entered_at >= c.created_at
 GROUP BY template_id ORDER BY visiting_profiles DESC

insights.name: Discover: active days and repeat use (30 days)
insights.description: Identified navigation, deduplicated by profile/space/UTC day. Same-day reloads do not inflate active days. Includes creation day. Repeat profiles entered attributed spaces on at least two distinct days in this window.
insights.query:
WITH creations AS (
 SELECT toString(properties.space_id) AS space_id,
 argMin(toString(properties.template_id), timestamp) AS template_id,
 argMin(distinct_id, timestamp) AS creator,
 argMin(toString(properties.identity_state), timestamp) AS creator_identity,
 min(timestamp) AS created_at
 FROM events
 WHERE event = 'space_conversion' AND properties.conversion = 'created'
 AND properties.environment = 'production'
 AND match(toString(properties.template_id), '^[a-f0-9]{16}$')
 AND match(toString(properties.space_id), '^[a-f0-9]{16}$')
 GROUP BY space_id
), entries AS (SELECT toString(properties.space_id) AS space_id, distinct_id AS profile,
 timestamp AS entered_at, toString(properties.identity_state) AS identity_state
 FROM events WHERE event = 'space_entered' AND properties.environment = 'production'
 AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY), profile_days AS (
 SELECT c.template_id AS template_id, e.profile AS profile,
 uniqExact(toDate(e.entered_at)) AS active_days,
 uniqExact(tuple(e.space_id, toDate(e.entered_at))) AS space_days
 FROM entries e JOIN creations c ON e.space_id = c.space_id
 WHERE e.identity_state = 'profile' AND match(e.profile, '^tonk:[a-f0-9]{64}$') AND e.entered_at >= c.created_at
 GROUP BY c.template_id, e.profile
)
 SELECT multiIf(template_id = '4ef4920da44a6ec2', 'kanoodel', template_id = '9b6eef20ae02d51a', 'little writer', template_id = '7b794d9527299625', 'Nightsky', template_id = 'fd4c8cd7dd36c33d', 'Welcome to Tonk', concat('Unlisted template ', template_id)) AS template, count() AS visiting_profiles,
 sum(active_days) AS profile_days, sum(space_days) AS profile_space_days,
 countIf(active_days >= 2) AS repeat_profiles,
 round(avg(active_days), 2) AS active_days_per_profile
 FROM profile_days GROUP BY template_id ORDER BY profile_days DESC

insights.name: Discover: creator return rates (mature cohorts)
insights.description: First observed identified creation per profile/template in the last 90 days; return must be to that same first space. D1 requires two UTC date boundaries; days 1-7 requires eight. Day zero excluded. Immature denominators give blank rates, not 0%.
insights.query:
WITH creations AS (
 SELECT toString(properties.space_id) AS space_id,
 argMin(toString(properties.template_id), timestamp) AS template_id,
 argMin(distinct_id, timestamp) AS creator,
 argMin(toString(properties.identity_state), timestamp) AS creator_identity,
 min(timestamp) AS created_at
 FROM events
 WHERE event = 'space_conversion' AND properties.conversion = 'created'
 AND properties.environment = 'production'
 AND match(toString(properties.template_id), '^[a-f0-9]{16}$')
 AND match(toString(properties.space_id), '^[a-f0-9]{16}$')
 GROUP BY space_id
), cohorts AS (
 SELECT template_id, creator, min(created_at) AS cohort_at,
 argMin(space_id, created_at) AS first_space
 FROM creations WHERE creator_identity = 'profile' AND match(creator, '^tonk:[a-f0-9]{64}$')
 GROUP BY template_id, creator
 HAVING cohort_at >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
), returns AS (
 SELECT c.template_id AS template_id, c.creator AS creator,
 c.cohort_at AS cohort_at,
 max(if(dateDiff('day', toDate(c.cohort_at), toDate(e.timestamp)) = 1, 1, 0)) AS returned_d1,
 max(if(dateDiff('day', toDate(c.cohort_at), toDate(e.timestamp)) BETWEEN 1 AND 7, 1, 0)) AS returned_d1_7
 FROM cohorts c LEFT JOIN (
 SELECT timestamp, distinct_id, toString(properties.space_id) AS space_id
 FROM events WHERE event = 'space_entered' AND properties.environment = 'production'
 AND properties.identity_state = 'profile' AND match(distinct_id, '^tonk:[a-f0-9]{64}$')
 AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
 ) e ON e.space_id = c.first_space AND e.distinct_id = c.creator
 GROUP BY c.template_id, c.creator, c.cohort_at
)

 SELECT multiIf(template_id = '4ef4920da44a6ec2', 'kanoodel', template_id = '9b6eef20ae02d51a', 'little writer', template_id = '7b794d9527299625', 'Nightsky', template_id = 'fd4c8cd7dd36c33d', 'Welcome to Tonk', concat('Unlisted template ', template_id)) AS template, count() AS creator_cohort,
 countIf(dateDiff('day', toDate(cohort_at), toDate(now())) >= 2) AS d1_eligible,
 sumIf(returned_d1, dateDiff('day', toDate(cohort_at), toDate(now())) >= 2) AS d1_returned,
 round(100.0 * d1_returned / nullIf(d1_eligible, 0), 1) AS d1_percent,
 countIf(dateDiff('day', toDate(cohort_at), toDate(now())) >= 8) AS d1_7_eligible,
 sumIf(returned_d1_7, dateDiff('day', toDate(cohort_at), toDate(now())) >= 8) AS d1_7_returned,
 round(100.0 * d1_7_returned / nullIf(d1_7_eligible, 0), 1) AS d1_7_percent
 FROM returns GROUP BY template_id ORDER BY creator_cohort DESC

insights.name: Discover: attribution coverage (30 days)
insights.description: All production space entries, including unresolved profiles and non-template spaces. Missing attribution is expected for blank, old, duplicated, or uncaptured creations. Counts are events, not unique users. Zero entries means no data, not zero retention.
insights.query:
WITH creations AS (
 SELECT toString(properties.space_id) AS space_id,
 argMin(toString(properties.template_id), timestamp) AS template_id,
 argMin(distinct_id, timestamp) AS creator,
 argMin(toString(properties.identity_state), timestamp) AS creator_identity,
 min(timestamp) AS created_at
 FROM events
 WHERE event = 'space_conversion' AND properties.conversion = 'created'
 AND properties.environment = 'production'
 AND match(toString(properties.template_id), '^[a-f0-9]{16}$')
 AND match(toString(properties.space_id), '^[a-f0-9]{16}$')
 GROUP BY space_id
), entries AS (SELECT toString(properties.space_id) AS space_id, distinct_id AS profile,
 timestamp AS entered_at, toString(properties.identity_state) AS identity_state
 FROM events WHERE event = 'space_entered' AND properties.environment = 'production'
 AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY)
 SELECT count() AS all_space_entries,
 countIf(notEmpty(c.template_id) AND e.entered_at >= c.created_at) AS template_attributed_entries,
 all_space_entries - template_attributed_entries AS unattributed_entries,
 countIf(notEmpty(c.template_id) AND e.entered_at >= c.created_at AND e.identity_state = 'profile' AND match(e.profile, '^tonk:[a-f0-9]{64}$')) AS attributed_identified_entries,
 round(100.0 * template_attributed_entries / nullIf(all_space_entries, 0), 1) AS attribution_percent
 FROM entries e LEFT JOIN creations c ON e.space_id = c.space_id
